session_read: Pre-open Monday: the book is unchanged from Friday's close ($42,547). Futures and Asia are firmly green (SMH +2.2% pre-market), but the regime is fragile: the Fed hiked on 09-16, the 10-year sits at 4.998%, and sentiment reads 75 (extreme greed). The CXMT memory threat is live for MU and SKHY only; the ASML/AMAT/TER links were examined and are not established. Four fresh proposals, all for review: trim MU, exit GLW, rotate AMD into KLAC.
